title: The Exact LinkedIn Post That Got Me 500+ Job Offers (Full Breakdown)
script: I posted one LinkedIn post and woke up to 500 recruiter messages and job offers. Not because I'm special. Because I used a structure most job seekers completely ignore. Four parts. Part one: the hook — a controversial opinion or an unexpected result. Part two: a three-sentence story that builds credibility. Part three: the actual value people came for. Part four: a question that drives comments. Why does this work? Because the algorithm rewards engagement. And a question at the end is the easiest comment to leave. Stop writing your resume in your LinkedIn post. Write a story that makes recruiters come to you.
